# Command line

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py -- do not edit. Run `make generate` after changing its source. -->

Every command answers `--help`. A refusal a person can act on -- a setting, a scope, a token, the daemon -- is one line on stderr and exit status 1. `sim-mirror --version` prints the version.

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `sim-mirror serve` | Run the SimMirror daemon on 127.0.0.1 |
| `sim-mirror mcp` | Serve the agent tools over stdio, for an MCP client |
| `sim-mirror open` | Open this project's simulator viewer in the browser |
| `sim-mirror doctor` | Check this Mac for what SimMirror needs |
| `sim-mirror config` | Show or change SimMirror's settings |
| `sim-mirror config path` | Print where config.toml is |
| `sim-mirror config validate` | Check config.toml and the SIM_MIRROR_ environment |
| `sim-mirror config list` | Every setting and its value |
| `sim-mirror config get` | One setting's value |
| `sim-mirror config set` | Set a setting in config.toml |
| `sim-mirror config unset` | Remove a setting from config.toml |
| `sim-mirror devices` | List this Mac's iOS simulators, or choose one for a project |
| `sim-mirror devices list` | List the simulators a project could use (the default) |
| `sim-mirror devices choose` | Use this simulator for a project from now on |
| `sim-mirror token` | Make, list or revoke the daemon's scoped tokens |
| `sim-mirror token create` | Make a token; it is printed only this once |
| `sim-mirror token list` | List the scoped tokens |
| `sim-mirror token revoke` | Stop accepting a token |
| `sim-mirror tools` | List the agent tools, as a connector with every capability offers them |
| `sim-mirror version` | Print the package, protocol and connector versions |

## `sim-mirror serve`

Run the SimMirror daemon on 127.0.0.1.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--port PORT` | the port to listen on, instead of server.port |
| `--config CONFIG` | the config.toml to read, instead of the usual one |
| `--detach` | start it in the background and return |
| `--foreground` | run it in this process (the default) |

## `sim-mirror mcp`

Serve the agent tools over stdio, for an MCP client.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--scope SCOPE` | the scope to drive, instead of this folder's project |
| `--root ROOT` | a folder builds and installs may reach; repeatable (default: here) |

## `sim-mirror open`

Open this project's simulator viewer in the browser.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--scope SCOPE` | the scope to show, instead of this folder's project |
| `--print` | print the URL instead of opening it |

## `sim-mirror doctor`

Check this Mac for what SimMirror needs.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | print the report as JSON |
| `--no-tap` | skip the real test tap on a simulator |
| `--device DEVICE` | the simulator (UDID) to tap, instead of a booted one |

## `sim-mirror config`

Show or change SimMirror's settings.

It takes no arguments.

## `sim-mirror config path`

Print where config.toml is.

It takes no arguments.

## `sim-mirror config validate`

Check config.toml and the SIM_MIRROR_ environment.

It takes no arguments.

## `sim-mirror config list`

Every setting and its value.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--scope SCOPE` | as this scope sees it |

## `sim-mirror config get`

One setting's value.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NAME` | a setting, such as stream.fps |
| `--scope SCOPE` | as this scope sees it |

## `sim-mirror config set`

Set a setting in config.toml.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NAME` |  |
| `VALUE` |  |
| `--scope SCOPE` | in this scope's own table |

## `sim-mirror config unset`

Remove a setting from config.toml.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NAME` |  |
| `--scope SCOPE` | from this scope's own table |

## `sim-mirror devices`

List this Mac's iOS simulators, or choose one for a project.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--scope SCOPE` | for this scope, instead of this folder's project |

## `sim-mirror devices list`

List the simulators a project could use (the default).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--scope SCOPE` | for this scope, instead of this folder's project |

## `sim-mirror devices choose`

Use this simulator for a project from now on.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `UDID` |  |
| `--scope SCOPE` | for this scope, instead of this folder's project |

## `sim-mirror token`

Make, list or revoke the daemon's scoped tokens.

It takes no arguments.

## `sim-mirror token create`

Make a token; it is printed only this once.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--kind KIND` |  (one of: agent, viewer, admin) |
| `--scope SCOPE` | a scope id, or * for all; repeatable |
| `--label LABEL` | what the token is for |
| `--root ROOT` | a folder an agent token may build in; repeatable |

## `sim-mirror token list`

List the scoped tokens.

It takes no arguments.

## `sim-mirror token revoke`

Stop accepting a token.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `ID` |  |

## `sim-mirror tools`

List the agent tools, as a connector with every capability offers them.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | print the manifest an MCP client receives |

## `sim-mirror version`

Print the package, protocol and connector versions.

It takes no arguments.
